intro: Converting acres (ac) to square feet (ft²) is essential when translating measurements across real estate land deeds, agricultural plot surveying, flooring estimation, and architectural floor plans. One acre equals 43,560 square feet, while one square foot equals 0.00002295 acres. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many square feet are in 1 acre?
faqs.answer: There are 43,560 square feet (ft²) in 1 acre (ac). To convert ac to ft², use the exact conversion factor 43,560.

faqs.question: How do I convert acres to square feet manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your acre value by 43,560 (exact factor: 43,560). For example, 0.75 ac × 43,560 = 32,670 ft².
